C0684.title: Female Exam Candidate Bulk-Booked Hotels Near Test Centers and Resold Rooms at Markup
C0684.summary: In March 2026, a woman preparing for a public-institution recruitment exam in Qixingguan District, Bijie, Guizhou used an accommodation app to reserve more than ten hotel rooms near exam sites to save exam-period transport and lodging costs, then resold them at higher prices to other candidates on social platforms. Police said the conduct was suspected of disrupting public order. Qixingguan police opened an investigation under the Public Security Administration Punishments Law, and the case remained under further handling.
